title: Cummins Investor Relations Announces Organizational Updates
body_markdown:
# Cummins Investor Relations Announces Organizational Updates


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_2418f0236309215c0561ba5aa1c61c1e/cummins/news/2026-08-24_Cummins_Investor_Relations_Announces_703.pdf) August 24, 2026 8:00am ET


We are pleased to announce several organizational updates within the Investor Relations team at Cummins Inc. These changes reflect our continued focus on delivering value to investors and stakeholders while supporting the company's long-term strategic priorities.


Please continue to contact members of the Investor Relations team directly with any inquiries, or reach us atinvestor.relations@cummins.com . No updates to your existing contact lists or email distribution lists are required.


**Investor Relations Organizational Updates:**


- **James Hopkins** , currently Vice President – Engine Business Finance & Strategy,[has been appointed to the newly created role of Vice President – Financial Planning, Capital Management and Investor Relations, effective September 1, 2026](https://www.cummins.com/en-na/news/releases/2026/08/24/cummins-appoints-james-hopkins-vice-president-financial-planning-capital) . He will report to Mark Smith, CFO. In this role, Hopkins will lead the company's financial planning, forecasting, target-setting, internal reporting and analysis activities, while also overseeing capital expenditures and investor engagement, working closely with business segment controllers and finance teams.
- **Nick Arens** will continue in his role as Executive Director, Investor Relations and Business Analysis & Planning, now reporting to James Hopkins.


To help introduce our team, please see the Investor Relations Team biographies below.


**INVESTOR RELATIONS TEAM**


Nick Arens joined IR in 2025 and serves as the Executive Director, Investor Relations and Business Analysis & Planning, reporting to James Hopkins, VP – Financial Planning, Capital Management and Investor Relations.


Formerly, Nick served as the Executive Director – Finance, Accelera and Components Strategy where he was responsible for all accounting practices, budgeting, financial controls and costs of the Accelera segment in addition to the development and execution of Accelera and Components segment strategies as part of the respective leadership teams.


Nick has been with Cummins for 14 years, joining in 2012 as a Manager in the Corporate Development group and focusing on the strategy and execution related to acquisitions, joint ventures, divestitures and restructurings. In 2017 Nick took a role in the Power Systems Business Unit (PSBU) Aftermarket business. While in PSBU, Nick led a portion of the Aftermarket business focused on service contracts while also leading the development of the first PSBU ‘digital’ product plan. In 2018, Nick had the opportunity to move into the Finance organization, becoming the Finance Director for the newly established Electrified Power business (now Accelera).


Prior to joining Cummins, Nick spent six years in consulting / advisory roles at Duff & Phelps in Chicago, IL (U.S.) as well as Blue & Co. in Indianapolis, IN (U.S.), with a specific focus on strategy, financial valuation and transaction structuring, primarily related to mergers, acquisitions and restructurings.


Nick also currently sits on Mark Smith's Executive Finance Leadership Team.


Colleen Koeberlein joined the investor relations team in October 2022, as Investor Relations Director. In this role, she is responsible for interactions with investors as well as engaging with the Business Analysis and Planning team for Cummins. Colleen joined Cummins in 2012, serving in various financial analysis, controller and reporting roles across the Distribution, Engine and Corporate segments.


In 2025 Colleen also expanded her role and accepted the position of Chief of Staff for Jen Rumsey, CEO.


Colin Curtis joined Investor Relations in August 2024 as an Investor Relations Senior Analyst. Colin began his career with Cummins as a finance intern and has been with Cummins since graduating college in 2020. Colin has held various analyst roles in Cummins including our Finance Development Program and Business Analysis & Planning.


Amanda joined Cummins in 2018 supporting our Finance Functional Excellence programs and Finance Development Program. Amanda joined the Investor Relations team as Chris Clulow's assistant in 2022 and currently serves as the Executive Coordinator for the IR team.


Released August 24, 2026
